title: Asterix - The Kingdom of Nubia (FCP 2026)

title_lang.zh_hk: 高盧英雄之努比亞王國 (FCP 2026)

synopsis: The irreducible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ended up into the magic potion. To find the antidote and save the village from the Roman attack, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

synopsis_lang.en: The irreducible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ended up into the magic potion. To find the antidote and save the village from the Roman attack, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 因為一瓶稀有的青春靈藥意外混入魔法藥水中，導致一群頑強不屈的高盧英雄竟變成人畜無害的小孩。為了尋找解藥，並拯救村莊免受羅馬人入侵，Asterix和Obelix 踏上一段瘋狂旅程，遠赴努比亞王國。
